coronary_arteries.name: Coronary arteries
coronary_arteries.origin: Right coronary artery: right aortic sinus. Left coronary artery: left aortic sinus of the ascending aorta.
coronary_arteries.course: Epicardial vessels follow the atrioventricular and interventricular grooves.
coronary_arteries.branches: Left main divides into LAD and circumflex. RCA gives atrial, nodal, marginal and ventricular branches. PDA origin depends on dominance.

left coronary artery.name: Left coronary artery
left coronary artery.origin: Left aortic sinus of ascending aorta
left coronary artery.branches: LAD and circumflex; ramus intermedius may occur

right coronary artery.name: Right coronary artery
right coronary artery.origin: Right aortic sinus of ascending aorta
right coronary artery.course: Right atrioventricular groove towards the crux
right coronary artery.branches: Conus, atrial, right marginal and ventricular branches; nodal supply varies. PDA and posterolateral branches in right dominance.

circumflex artery.name: Circumflex Artery
circumflex artery.branches: Left marginal, atrial and posterior ventricular branches; PDA in left dominance

portal vein.name: Portal vein
portal vein.origin: Union of superior mesenteric and splenic veins behind pancreatic neck
portal vein.tributaries: Gastric, cystic, paraumbilical and other portal tributaries; IMV usually joins splenic vein
portal vein.drainsTo: Right and left portal branches, then hepatic sinusoids
portal vein.course: Portal inflow to liver, distinct from hepatic venous outflow

papillary_left.name: Left ventricular papillary muscles
papillary_left.insertion: Chordae tendineae to mitral valve leaflets
papillary_left.innervation: Cardiac conduction system; autonomic modulation, not somatic motor innervation
papillary_left.action: Tenses chordae during systole, limiting leaflet prolapse

papillary_right.name: Right ventricular papillary muscles
papillary_right.insertion: Chordae tendineae to tricuspid valve leaflets
papillary_right.innervation: Cardiac conduction system; autonomic modulation, not somatic motor innervation
papillary_right.action: Tenses chordae during systole, limiting leaflet prolapse

perineal_group.name: Superficial perineal muscle group
perineal_group.origin: Component-specific attachments in ischial and perineal regions
perineal_group.innervation: Pudendal perineal branches; inferior rectal branches for external anal sphincter
perineal_group.action: Perineal support and component-specific sphincter/sexual functions
perineal_group.scopeNote: FMA19728 is a muscle class, not one uniquely identified transverse muscle.

great saphenous vein.name: Great saphenous vein
great saphenous vein.origin: Medial marginal vein of foot, continuing the medial dorsal venous arch
great saphenous vein.tributaries: Superficial epigastric, superficial circumflex iliac, superficial external pudendal and accessory saphenous veins; communicating channels vary
great saphenous vein.drainsTo: Femoral vein at the saphenofemoral junction
great saphenous vein.course: Anterior to medial malleolus, then medial leg and thigh

posterior interventricular artery.name: Posterior Interventricular Artery
posterior interventricular artery.origin: RCA in right dominance; circumflex in left dominance

conus artery.name: Conus Artery
conus artery.origin: Usually proximal RCA; separate aortic origin may occur

anterior communicating artery.name: Anterior Communicating Artery
anterior communicating artery.branches: Small basal forebrain and hypothalamic perforators

posterior communicating artery.name: Posterior Communicating Artery
posterior communicating artery.branches: Hypothalamic and other perforating branches; connects with PCA

callosomarginal artery.name: Callosomarginal Artery
callosomarginal artery.branches: Medial frontal and paracentral branches; pattern varies

pericallosal artery.name: Pericallosal Artery
pericallosal artery.branches: Callosomarginal and other medial cortical branches

thalamoperforating artery.name: Thalamoperforating Artery
thalamoperforating artery.origin: Posterior cerebral or posterior communicating arterial system, depending on branch

thoracoacromial artery.name: Thoracoacromial Artery
thoracoacromial artery.branches: Pectoral, deltoid, acromial and clavicular branches

superior intercostal artery.name: Superior Intercostal Artery
superior intercostal artery.branches: First and second posterior intercostal arteries

dorsal scapular artery.name: Dorsal Scapular Artery
dorsal scapular artery.origin: Subclavian artery or deep transverse cervical branch

gastroduodenal artery.name: Gastroduodenal Artery
gastroduodenal artery.branches: Right gastro-omental and superior pancreaticoduodenal arteries

right gastric artery.name: Right Gastric Artery
right gastric artery.origin: Usually hepatic artery proper; origin varies

inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery.name: Inferior Pancreaticoduodenal Artery
inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery.origin: Superior mesenteric artery; sometimes jejunal source

proper palmar digital arteries.name: Proper Palmar Digital Arteries
proper palmar digital arteries.origin: Common palmar digital arteries or named radial digital sources, according to digit

dorsal digital arteries.name: Dorsal Digital Arteries
dorsal digital arteries.origin: Dorsal metacarpal or metatarsal arteries according to region

coronary sinus.name: Coronary Sinus
coronary sinus.origin: Continuation of great cardiac vein with oblique vein contribution
coronary sinus.tributaries: Great, middle, small cardiac and posterior LV/marginal tributaries

posterior vein of the left ventricle.name: Posterior Vein Of The Left Ventricle
posterior vein of the left ventricle.drainsTo: Coronary sinus, sometimes via great cardiac vein

hepatic veins.name: Hepatic Veins
hepatic veins.origin: Intrahepatic venous channels collecting sinusoidal outflow

middle hepatic vein.name: Middle Hepatic Vein
middle hepatic vein.drainsTo: IVC, often in common trunk with left hepatic vein

suprarenal vein.name: Suprarenal Vein
suprarenal vein.drainsTo: Right: IVC. Left: left renal vein, usually after joining inferior phrenic vein

superficial dorsal vein of the penis.name: Superficial Dorsal Vein Of The Penis

deep dorsal vein of the penis.name: Deep Dorsal Vein Of The Penis

musculophrenic vein.name: Musculophrenic Vein
musculophrenic vein.origin: Lower anterior thoracic and diaphragmatic venous channels

lateral circumflex femoral vein.name: Lateral Circumflex Femoral Vein
lateral circumflex femoral vein.drainsTo: Deep femoral or femoral vein; termination varies

medial circumflex femoral vein.name: Medial Circumflex Femoral Vein
medial circumflex femoral vein.drainsTo: Deep femoral or femoral vein; termination varies

subcostal vein.name: Subcostal Vein
subcostal vein.drainsTo: Right: azygos system. Left: hemiazygos system

median sacral vein.name: Median Sacral Vein
median sacral vein.drainsTo: Common iliac venous system, often left common iliac vein

gastric vein.name: Gastric Vein
gastric vein.tributaries: Gastric and esophageal tributaries depend on named vessel
gastric vein.drainsTo: Portal or splenic venous system according to named gastric vein

gastroepiploic vein.name: Gastroepiploic Vein
gastroepiploic vein.drainsTo: Right: superior mesenteric system. Left: splenic vein

plantar venous arch.name: Plantar Venous Arch
plantar venous arch.origin: Plantar metatarsal and digital venous channels
plantar venous arch.drainsTo: Medial/lateral plantar and posterior tibial venous system

proper palmar digital vein.name: Proper Palmar Digital Vein
proper palmar digital vein.drainsTo: Common palmar digital veins and communicating dorsal channels
